data.desc: Corteva, Inc. (NYSE: CTVA) is a global crop protection company with a leading portfolio of differentiated solutions, including award-winning conventional chemistries and advantaged biologicals, seed-applied technologies and nature-inspired products that help farmers increase yields and protect crops from the stresses of weather, insects, weeds and diseases. Driven by a robust innovation pipeline, deep customer relationships, operational excellence, and disciplined capital allocation, Corteva is focused on creating value for its farmers, channel partners, employees, shareholders, and the communities in which it operates.
